related.title: Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦
related.why: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.whyEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.transfer: 可遷移節點、互連、I/O及復原的分層分析；拓撲、資源配置與工作流不同。
related.transferEn: Layered node, fabric, I/O and recovery analysis transfers, with different topology, resources and workflows.
related.difference: 本課針對APU 共享 HBM 與 Slingshot 系統架構；Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦改以異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on apu shared hbm and slingshot systems; Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer centers on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照MI300A共享HBM與GH200相干記憶，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以節點排程與一致性為起點，設計一項能區分「APU 共享 HBM 與 Slingshot 系統架構」與「異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare mi300a shared hbm with gh200 coherent memory and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from node scheduling and consistency and propose an observation distinguishing apu shared hbm and slingshot systems from heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links, including uncertainty.

history.textEn: Public sources for El Capitan MI300A supercomputer illustrate apu shared hbm and slingshot systems. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.
